# NBAPI 1.4.3

## Compatibility

- Restored a Moonshot-specific `/v1/responses` to `/v1/chat/completions` conversion path, independent of the channel conversion switch.
- Matched the safer 1.2.0 Moonshot behavior by only forwarding ChatCompletions-compatible `function` tools to Moonshot upstreams.
- Dropped unsupported Responses tool shapes such as `namespace`, `plugin`, and `custom_tool_call` from Moonshot chat tool calls to avoid upstream `tokenization failed` and `unknown tool type` errors.
- Kept internal ChatCompletions-to-Responses routing from being converted back to chat, so global chat-to-responses policy still works correctly.

## Validation

- Added Moonshot conversion tests for unsupported tool filtering, valid function-call history preservation, orphan tool-output handling, and internal routing protection.
